query:
SELECT
            al.timestamp,
            al.ip_address,
            al.request_path,
            g.government_name,
            g.country_name
        FROM audit_logs al
        LEFT JOIN governments g ON al.government_id = g.id
        WHERE al.action = 'rate_limit_exceeded'
          AND al.timestamp >= NOW() - ($1::integer || ' hours')::interval
        ORDER BY al.timestamp DESC
        LIMIT 100
